applications.description: Proposed development to create a new single storey warehouse with ancillary two storey research laboratory and training facility together with car parking and associated landscaping.

conditions.summary: Time limit for commencement (3 years)
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Detailed drainage strategy (sustainable drainage)
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted, a detailed drainage strategy, in line with the illustrative scheme submitted at application stage, shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved drainage system shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Strategy prior to the use of the building commencing and maintained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Landscaping scheme (hard and soft landscaping, boundary treatments)
conditions.text: The development herby permitted shall not be implemented until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a scheme of hard and soft landscaping, including all boundary treatments, and shall include indications of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, and details of any to be retained, together with measures for their protection, in the course of development. The approved scheme shall be implemented so that planting is carried out no later than the first planting season following the occupation of the building(s) or the completion of the development whichever is the sooner.

conditions.summary: Construction Management Plan (hours, parking, routes, traffic management)
conditions.text: No development shall take place, including any demolition works, until a construction management plan or construction method statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved plan/statement shall be adhered to throughout the demolition/construction period. The plan/statement shall provide for: 24 hour emergency contact number; Hours of operation; Parking of vehicle of site operatives and visitors (including measures taken to ensure satisfactory access and movement for existing occupiers of neighbouring properties during construction); Routes for construction traffic; Locations for loading/unloading and storage of plant, waste and construction materials; Method of preventing mud being carried onto the highway; Measures to protect vulnerable road users (cyclists and pedestrians) Any necessary temporary traffic management measures; Arrangements for turning vehicles; Arrangements to receive abnormal loads or unusually large vehicles; Methods of communicating the Construction Management Plan to staff, visitors and neighbouring residents and businesses.

conditions.summary: Land contamination site characterisation (investigation and risk assessment)
conditions.text: No development shall take place until an investigation and risk assessment, in addition to any assessment provided with the planning application, and has been completed in accordance with a scheme to assess the nature and extent of any contamination on the site, whether or not it originates on the site. The contents of the scheme should be submitted to and be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken by competent persons and a written report of the findings must be produced. The written report is subject to the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. The report of the findings must include: (i) a survey of the extent, scale and nature of contamination; (ii) an assessment of the potential risks to: human health, property (existing or proposed) including buildings, crops, livestock, pets, woodland and service lines and pipes, adjoining land, groundwaters and surface waters, ecological systems, archaeological sites and ancient monuments; (iii) an appraisal of remedial options, and proposal of the preferred option(s).

conditions.summary: Land contamination remediation scheme (detailed scheme submission)
conditions.text: No development shall take place until a detailed remediation scheme to bring the site to a condition suitable for the intended use by removing unacceptable risks to human health, buildings and other property and the natural and historical environment has been prepared, submitted to and been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme must include all works to be undertaken, proposed remediation objectives and remediation criteria, timetable of works and site management procedures. The scheme must ensure that the site will not qualify as contaminated land under Part 2A of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 in relation to the intended use of the land after remediation.

conditions.summary: Land contamination implementation of approved remediation scheme
conditions.text: In the event that contamination is found, no development other than that required to be carried out as part of an approved scheme of remediation shall take place until the approved remediation scheme has been carried out in accordance with its terms. The Local Planning Authority must be given two weeks written notification of commencement of the remediation scheme works. Following completion of measures identified in the approved remediation scheme, a verification report that demonstrates the effectiveness of the remediation carried out must be produced, and be approved in writing of the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Site clearance (bird nesting season protection)
conditions.text: No clearance of vegetation or structures suitable for nesting birds shall take place during the bird nesting season (between 1st March and 31st August inclusive in any year) without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. If works are proposed within this period evidence shall be provided by a suitably qualified ecologist that no breeding birds would be adversely affected, including by disturbance before giving any approval under this condition, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Landscape and Ecological Management Plan (30-year LEMP)
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, the applicant shall submit a 30-year Landscape and Ecological Management Plan (LEMP). This should address retained features of ecological interest, together with mitigation and enhancements to be provided. The LEMP should set out management compartments, objectives, and prescriptions. It should also show how management of the site will be resourced and monitored. Prior to commencement the LEMP shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and thereafter the soft landscaping at the site shall be managed in accordance with the approved LEMP.

conditions.summary: Energy and Sustainability measures (20% CO2 reduction beyond Part L 2013)
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall incorporate the energy efficiency measures, renewable energy, sustainable design principles and climate change adaptation measures into the design and construction of the development in full accordance with the energy and sustainability statement within the document entitled Additional Details by Sci-Entec (Doc. Ref. No. L602/va.Power-Sprays) prior to occupation or use commenced. A total of at least 20% reduction in carbon dioxide emissions beyond Part L 2013 Building Regulations in line with the energy hierarchy shall be achieved.

conditions.summary: Further details before work started (PV panels, air source heat pumps)
conditions.text: Detailed drawings and specification of the following shall be submitted to and be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of work is begun. The detail thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval. a) Photovoltaic Panels; b) Air Source Heat Pumps

conditions.summary: Implementation of refuse storage and recycling facilities
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or use commenced until the refuse store and area/facilities allocated for storing of recyclable materials, as shown on the approved plans have been completed in accordance with the approved plans. Thereafter, all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development shall either be stored within this dedicated store/area, as shown on the approved plans, or internally within the building(s) that form part of the application site. No refuse or recycling material shall be stored or placed for collection on the adopted highway (including the footway), except on the day of collection.

conditions.summary: Completion and maintenance of vehicular servicing facilities
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or use commenced until the facilities for loading, unloading, circulation and manoeuvring have been completed in accordance with the approved plans. Thereafter, these areas shall be kept free of obstruction and available for these uses.

conditions.summary: Completion and maintenance of car/vehicle parking
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or use commenced until the car/vehicle parking area (and turning space) shown on the approved plans has been completed and thereafter the area shall be kept free of obstruction and available for the parking of vehicles associated with the development. Driveways/vehicle parking areas accessed from the adopted highway must be properly consolidated and surfaced, (not loose stone, gravel or grasscrete) and subsequently maintained in good working order at all times thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: Completion and maintenance of cycle parking provision
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or the use commenced until the cycle parking provision shown on the approved plans has been completed, and thereafter, be kept free of obstruction and available for the parking of cycles only.

conditions.summary: Materials (as specified on approved plans)
conditions.text: Development shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans PIN946(15)02 Rev. A unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan (commercial property)
conditions.text: No building or use herby permitted shall be occupied or the use commenced until the applicant has submitted to and had approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan (FEP). This Plan shall include the following information: command & control (decision making process and communications to ensure activation of FEP); training and exercising of personnel on site (H& S records of to whom and when); flood warning procedures (in terms of receipt and transmission of information and to whom); site evacuation procedures and routes; and provision for identified safe refuges (who goes there and resources to sustain them). The FEP shall be reviewed at intervals not exceeding 3 years, and will form part of the Health & Safety at Work Register maintained by the applicant.

conditions.summary: Finished floor level (no lower than 8.150 m AOD)
conditions.text: The finished floor level of the building hereby approved shall be no lower than 8.150 m AOD.

conditions.summary: Reporting of unexpected contamination
conditions.text: In the event that contamination is found at any time when carrying out the approved development that was not previously identified it must be reported in writing immediately to the Local Planning Authority. An investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken in accordance with the requirements of Condition 5 and where remediation is necessary a remediation scheme must be prepared in accordance with the requirements of Condition 6, which is to be submitted to and be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Following completion of measures identified in the approved remediation scheme a verification report must be prepared, which is subject to the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority in accordance with condition 7.

conditions.summary: Time limit for commencement of development
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: Noise Sensitive Premises Assessment
conditions.text: No development shall take place until a detailed acoustic report on the existing noise climate at the development site has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Council. The report shall include a scheme of noise insulation measures for all residential accommodation. The noise insulation measures shall be designed to achieve noise insulation to a standard that nuisance will not be caused to the occupiers of residential accommodation by noise from existing licensed and commercial premises in the area. The noise assessment shall be carried out by a suitably qualified acoustic consultant/engineer and shall take into account the provisions of BS4142: 2014 Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound and BS 8233: 2014 Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings. The approved scheme shall be implemented prior to the commencement of the use and be permanently maintained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Intrusive site investigation
conditions.text: A site specific risk assessment and intrusive investigation shall be carried out to assess the nature and extent of any site contamination and whether or not it originates from the site. The investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken by competent persons and a written report of the findings must be produced. The results of this investigation shall be considered along with the reports submitted with the original application. The written report of the findings shall be submitted to an approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any works (except demolition) in connection with the development, hereby approved, commencing on site. This must be conducted in accordance with the Environment Agency's 'Land Contamination: risk management' and BS 10175:2011 + A2:2017.

conditions.summary: Submission of Remediation Scheme
conditions.text: No development shall take place (except demolition) until a detailed remediation scheme to bring the site to a condition suitable for the intended use by removing unacceptable risks to human health, buildings and other property and the natural and historical environment has been prepared, submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme must include all works to be undertaken, proposed remediation objectives and remediation criteria, timetable of works and site management procedures. In the event that contamination is found, no occupation of the development shall take place until the approved remediation scheme has been carried out in accordance with its terms.

conditions.summary: Unexploded Ordnance
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development a detailed unexploded ordnance survey shall be carried out at the site to establish whether there is any unexploded ordnance, the details of which shall include any necessary mitigation measures and shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval. The development shall be undertaken in full accordance with any approved mitigation measures.

conditions.summary: Renewable energy (Air Source Heat Pump) - further detail required
conditions.text: Prior to commencement, details of the renewable energy technology (including the exact location, dimensions, design/ technical specification)should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. The renewable energy technology shall be installed prior to occupation of the development, and thereafter retained.

conditions.summary: Details of Photovoltaics (PV)
conditions.text: Prior to commencement, details of the proposed PV system including location, dimensions, design/ technical specification together with calculation of annual energy generation (kWh/annum) and associated reduction in residual CO2 emissions shall be provided.

conditions.summary: Electric Vehicle Charging Points
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or use commenced until details of the total number of car parking spaces, the number/type/location/means of operation and a programme for the installation and maintenance of Electric Vehicle Charging Points and points of passive provision for the integration of future charging points has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to construction of the above ground works. The Electric Vehicle Charging Points as approved shall be installed prior to occupation and retained in that form thereafter for the lifetime of the development.

conditions.summary: External Illumination/Lighting details
conditions.text: No occupation is hereby permitted until full details of the proposed external lighting plan have been submitted for written approval by the planning authority. Once approved the lighting shall be installed in accordance with plans and remain in place for perpetuity.

conditions.summary: Implementation/Installation of Refuse Storage and Recycling Facilities
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or use commenced until the refuse store and area/facilities allocated for storing of recyclable materials, as shown on the approved plans have been completed in accordance with the approved plans. Thereafter, all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development shall either be stored within this dedicated store/area, as shown on the approved plans, or internally within the building(s) that form part of the application site. No refuse or recycling material shall be stored or placed for collection on the adopted highway (including the footway), except on the day of collection.

conditions.summary: Reporting of Unexpected Contamination
conditions.text: In the event that contamination is found at any time that had not previously been identified when carrying out the approved development, it must be reported immediately to the Local Planning Authority. An investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken in accordance with the Environment Agency's 'Land Contamination: risk management' guidance and BS 10175:2011 + A2:2017.

conditions.summary: Completion and Maintenance of Cycle Provision
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or the use commenced until the cycle parking provision shown on the approved plans has been completed, and thereafter, be kept free of obstruction and available for the parking of cycles only.

conditions.summary: Completion of Pedestrians/Cyclists Access
conditions.text: No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or the use commenced until the means of access for pedestrians and/or cyclists have been constructed in accordance with the approved plans and shall thereafter be retained for access purposes only.

conditions.summary: Energy and Sustainability in accordance
conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until the energy efficiency measures, renewable energy, sustainable design principles and climate change adaptation measures contained in the Energy Statement and Sustainability Statement (Fenton Energy Ltd, February 2024) have been implemented in full. The measures shall be retained as such thereafter unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Bird and Bat Boxes
conditions.text: Prior to occupation of the development details provided by a qualified ecological consultant shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority providing the specification, orientation, height and location for built-in bird nesting and bat roosting opportunities integrated within buildings and shown on a site plan with compass directions marked on it. This shall include three built-in bird and two built-in bat boxes or bricks. Bird boxes shall be installed to face between north and east to avoid direct sunlight and heavy rain. Bird boxes shall be erected out of the reach of predators and at least 3.5 metres high on publicly accessible sites.

conditions.summary: Non opening and obscured glazed window
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking and/or re-enacting that Order) the proposed EAST ELEVATION window shall be non-opening and glazed with obscure glass to a specification to be agreed with the Local Planning Authority and shall be permanently maintained thereafter as non opening and obscure glazed.

Inside: De-plant of services building, de-plant of main Polymers II warehouse, de-plant of extruder room. Note: No main structures to be removed.

conditions.summary: Compliance with Schedule 2, Part 11, Class B of GPDO 2015
conditions.text: The proposed demolition and associated works are found to be in accordance with Schedule 2, Part 11, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (As Amended). On the basis of the information submitted, the Local Planning Authority's prior approval is required and is hereby given subject to advices.

conditions.summary: Demolition Environmental Management Plan, Dust and Method Statement
conditions.text: No demolition shall take place until a site specific Demolition Environmental Management Plan (DEMP), Dust Management Plan (DMP) and Demolition Method Statement (DMS) has been submitted to and been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plan/statements must demonstrate the adoption and use of the best practicable means to reduce the effects of contamination risks, noise, vibration, dust and site lighting on the surrounding area and all surrounding premises and infrastructure. The approved DEMP, DMP and DMS shall be adhered to throughout the demolition period.

conditions.summary: Contamination Watching Brief during demolition
conditions.text: During demolition the applicants shall undertake a watching brief for contamination, with records kept to inform future site investigation. This shall include, but not necessarily be limited to: - Details of any waste transfer notes and testing undertaken - Details of the locations and depths of the redundant drainage networks. If the drainage runs are infilled only clean inert material should be used. - If significant issues are identified that require immediate action, please contact pollution@bristol.gov.uk or call 01179 222500 option 3 to discuss the works.

conditions.summary: Method Statement for internal refurbishment
conditions.text: A detailed method statement for the internal refurbishment of the subject unit shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant parts of work is begun. The detail thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the method statement. The statement shall contain: 1. Further details regarding the treatment to metalwork and an appropriate method for undertaking any cleaning or restoration. 2. The method of removing and restoring boxed in wall bays, including the recording of their condition and the approach for preserving surviving plaster work as well as restoring areas where original fabric has been lost.

conditions.summary: Materials to be used as specified on approved plans
conditions.text: Development shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Protection of existing internal features
conditions.text: All existing internal decoration features, including plaster work, ironwork, fireplaces, doors, windows, staircases, staircase balustrade and other woodwork, shall remain undisturbed in their existing position, and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site unless expressly specified in the approved drawings.

conditions.summary: New works to match existing fabric (Listed Building)
conditions.text: All new external and internal works and finishes, and any works of making good, shall match the existing original fabric in respect of using materials of a matching form, composition and consistency, detailed execution and finished appearance, except where indicated otherwise on the drawings hereby approved.

conditions.summary: Partitions to be scribed around ornamental plaster mouldings

conditions.summary: Use of breathable paint on traditional materials

conditions.summary: Advertisement owner permission
conditions.text: No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.

conditions.summary: Advertisement safety and traffic hazard restrictions
conditions.text: No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to:- (a) endanger persons using any highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military); (b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or (c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.

conditions.summary: Advertisement maintenance and visual amenity
conditions.text: Any advertisement displayed and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.

conditions.summary: Advertisement structure maintenance and public safety
conditions.text: Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public.

conditions.summary: Advertisement removal and site restoration
conditions.text: Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity.

conditions.summary: No overhang of adopted highway
conditions.text: No part of the advertisement(s) shall overhang the adopted highway.

conditions.summary: Sign clearance and projection distances
conditions.text: The proposed sign shall have a minimum clearance of 2.7 metres above the level of the adjoining footway and shall not project closer than 0.45 metres to the carriageway edge.

conditions.summary: Non-reflective materials and glare prevention
conditions.text: Any advertisement displayed shall be finished and thereafter retained in non-reflective materials so as not to dazzle or distract motorists.

conditions.summary: Illuminated advertisement design standards
conditions.text: Any illuminated advertisement shall be designed so that:- (a) no part of the source of the illumination shall at any time be directly visible to users of adjacent adopted highway; (b) static illumination is provided and shall not feature intermittent or flashing lights; (c) the level of illumination shall not at any time exceed 300 cd/m²; (d) moving features shall not be provided.

conditions.summary: Consent time restriction of five years
conditions.text: This consent shall be restricted to a period of five years from the date of the consent.

conditions.summary: Conformity with approved plans and drawings

applications.description: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no. 29 (as inserted by non-material amendment Ref PP/2015/3100) pursuant to planning permission reference P/2008/3284 Dated 13.01.2009 "Erection of part 5, 6 and 9 storey building with mezzanine floor and basement to form 165 bed hotel with ancillary restaurant/bar and 3434 square metres of B1(a) data centre/office accommodation; alteration to western vehicular access and closure of eastern vehicular access; provision of 39 car parking spaces (including 14 disabled spaces); cycle parking, loading bay and associated landscaping". Variation seeks to incorporate a lift shaft to the eastern elevation.

conditions.summary: Vehicular site access details to be submitted and approved
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the details submitted, full details of the proposed vehicular site access shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and the approved detail shall be completed prior to the first use of any part of the building hereby permitted.

conditions.summary: Nine wheelchair accessible hotel bedrooms to be provided
conditions.text: Nine wheelchair accessible hotel bedrooms shall be provided unless otherwise agreed by the local planning authority, details of which shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to commencement of works. The approved details shall be implemented prior to first occupation of any part of the hotel and these rooms shall be retained as such thereafeter.

conditions.summary: No external access to roof or additional plant/equipment
conditions.text: No external access shall be gained to the top of the building except for the purposes of essential servicing and maintenance and for no other purpose. Further, no additional plant, air conditioning or satellite dishes shall be erected on any part of the roof of the approved building.

conditions.summary: Wheelchair access details within site to be submitted and approved
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the access arrangements detailed on the plans hereby approved, prior to commencement of development, satisfactory details of wheelchair access within the site shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. Development shall proceed in accordance with the details as approved, and be retained as such thereafter.

conditions.summary: Contaminated land investigation and remediation
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of any works on site, the applicant shall carry out a contaminated land investigation that shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Sampling points and methods of investigation shall be agreed in writing with the Principal Environmental Health Officer prior to the investigation and if deemed necessary by the Local Planning Authority, a scheme shall be submitted for the removal, neutralising and sealing of any contamination, and the approved remedial works shall be implemented before building works commence in the interests of occupiers of neighbouring sites.

conditions.summary: Servicing hours restricted to 7am-7pm Monday-Saturday
conditions.text: Servicing for the hotel and offices shall only take place between the hours of 7.00am and 7.00pm Monday's to Saturdays and not at any time on Sundays or Bank Holidays.

conditions.summary: Site construction method statement and management plan
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of any development, details of a site construction method statement/management plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The method statement/management plan shall include the following: - on-site construction worker parking - anticipated number, frequency and size of construction vehicles entering/exiting the site - delivery times (staggered to avoid morning and afternoon school run peak periods) - dust suppression measures - site security - vehicle manoeuvring and turning, including sweep path diagrams to demonstrate how vehicles will access the site and be able to turn into and emerge from the site in forward gear - details as to the locations for the storage of building materials and construction debris and contractors offices - procedures for on-site contractors to deal with complaints from local residents.

conditions.summary: Bar and restaurant use ancillary to hotel only
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 and the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting those Orders with or without modification), the bar and restaurant use on part of the ground floor of the development shall only be used as an ancillary function to the hotel use and for no other purpose, including retail purposes or a separate use.

conditions.summary: Crime prevention and security measures complying with Secured by Design
conditions.text: Details of crime prevention and security measures for the buildings, car parking areas, cycle parking areas (including access controls to the car park and entrance doors), hard and soft landscaped areas and bin storage areas, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to commencement of development. The details shall comply with the aims and objectives of the Metropolitan Police requirements of Secured By Design. The approved details shall be implemented before the first occupation of the development, and be permanently retained.

conditions.summary: Sustainability measures including renewable energy and BREEAM very good
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development, details of the sustainability measures that are to be incorporated into the development hereby approved, as set out in the Energy Statement, shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details of sustainability measures shall include: + Wet centralised chiller plant for the data centre; + Roof top mounted photovoltaic panels generating a minimum of 26kWp; + Either heat recovery and reuse from the data centre chiller plant or a gas fired CHP for the hotel element of the scheme hereby approved; + Use of semi permeable surfacing for access paths and car parking areas within the site and demonstration of effective slow release of water from this material to vegetated areas.

conditions.summary: Restaurant odour abatement equipment and exhaust stack details
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the information indicated on the submitted plans, fitting out of the restaurant shall not take place until full details of the installation and operation of the best practicable odour abatement equipment and the height of the exhaust stack for the restaurant, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details as approved shall be implemented prior to first use of the restaurant and permanently retained and maintained in accordance with the manufacturers specification thereafter.

conditions.summary: External plant noise limit assessed under BS4142 (5dBA below background)
conditions.text: Details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of construction, to demonstrate that the rating noise level emitted from the proposed external plant and machinery of the development hereby approved, as assessed under BS4142: 1997, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by at least 5 dBA as measured at 3.5 m from the nearest ground floor sensitive facade and 1m from upper floor noise sensitive facades, during the relevant periods of operation.

conditions.summary: Building envelope protection from external noise, vibration and odour
conditions.text: Details of measures for protecting the building envelope (roof, walls and windows) of the offices and hotel from external noise, vibration and odour, including aircraft noise and internal separation between the ground floor refuse storage area and the remainder of the building, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any part of the development is commenced. The works shall be carried out as approved before first occupation and shall thereafter be retained.

conditions.summary: Detailed Green Travel Plan with targets and monitoring
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the Green Travel Plan submitted with the application, a more detailed Green Travel Plan including targets shall be submitted to and approved in writing, prior to the occupation of the proposal hereby permitted and this approved Green Travel Plan shall be implemented as agreed, and be permanently retained and targets within the Plan shall be subject to monitoring by the Local Planning Authority on an annual basis or timetable as otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Car parking spaces to disabled standard details
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the information contained in the application, detailed drawings to show 14 car parking spaces for the approved offices and hotel uses set out to disabled space standard, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences and the details so approved shall be implemented before first occupation of any of the offices or hotel and shall thereafter be retained.

conditions.summary: Car parking space division between hotel and data centre
conditions.text: Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, details shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority to specify the division of the car parking spaces between the hotel and data centre. The car parking spaces and associated access areas shall be formed, marked out on the site and available for use in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved and these spaces shall be kept continuously available for car parking, and shall not be used for any other purpose.

conditions.summary: Cycle parking implementation and retention
conditions.text: The cycle parking shown on the approved plans shall be implemented and brought into use prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved and permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: External lighting details complying with ILE Guidance Notes and BS5489
conditions.text: Details of all external lighting to be erected, demonstrating compliance with the recommendations of the Institution of Lighting Engineers 'Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Light Pollution' and the provisions of BS 5489 Part 9, shall be submitted in writing to, and approved by, the Local Planning Authority prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved. The lighting as approved shall be installed prior to first use of the buildings and be maintained in accordance with these standards thereafter.

conditions.summary: Commencement of development within three years
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: External materials samples to be submitted and approved
conditions.text: Samples and/or detailed information of the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any part of the development is commenced, and this condition shall apply notwithstanding any indications as to these matters which have been given in this application. The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping details with phased programme
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the details submitted on MZ01_P-010 Rev E of ref. P/2008/3284, first occupation of the development hereby approved shall not take place until full details of both hard and soft landscaping works, including a phased programme of works to the Uxbridge Road frontage, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed by the Local Planning Authority. Any trees or other plants, which die or are removed within the first five years following the implementation of the landscaping scheme, shall be replaced during the next planting season of this prominent site alongside one of the main traffic routes in the Town Centre.

conditions.summary: Landscape maintenance schedule for 5 years minimum
conditions.text: Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, a schedule of landscape maintenance for a minimum period of 5 years from the implementation of final planting has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Landscape maintenance shall be carried out in accordance with the approved schedule.

conditions.summary: Tree protection measures for retained trees
conditions.text: Details of the works necessary to protect the trees to be retained within and adjacent to the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development and the approved details shall be implemented prior to commencement of the development and retained until it is completed. No materials, plant, other equipment, storage or other works shall take place at any time within the enclosed area around the trees to be retained.

conditions.summary: Boundary treatment design and materials details
conditions.text: First occupation of the development hereby approved shall not take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment (including any acoustic treatment adjacent to residential site boundaries, internal fences, walls and railings to the proposed roof areas) to be erected. The boundary treatment shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and completed prior to first occupation of the approved development and permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Air Quality Assessment and remedial measures
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of any works on site, an Air Quality Assessment shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to determine the effect of the development on air quality and the exposure of future occupants to air pollutants, and any remedial measures necessary to achieve a satisfactory standard of air quality shall be implemented prior to first occupation of any of the development hereby approved, and permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Restriction to hotel and office use only
conditions.text: The building hereby approved shall only be used for a hotel with ancillary bar and restaurant and for the office use described in the planning application as defined respectively within Classes C1 and E of the Town and Country Planning (Use Class) Order 1987 (as amended) and for no other purpose including any other use within the respective use classes unless planning permission has first been obtained via the submission of a planning application.

conditions.summary: Bar and restaurant operating hours 0600-0030 Monday-Sunday
conditions.text: The ancillary bar and restaurant use hereby permitted within the ground-floor of the hotel shall not operate outside the hours of 0600 - 00.30hrs Monday to Sunday, including Bank and Public Holidays.

conditions.summary: Servicing, refuse and recycling collection arrangements
conditions.text: First occupation of the development hereby approved shall not take place until details of servicing and refuse and recycling collection arrangements have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include a refuse management plan that prevents occupants from siting at any time refuse and/or recycling bins on any road frontage. Refuse and recycling collection shall not take place between the hours of 2200 and 0700 on any day. The approved arrangements shall be implemented prior to first occupation of any of the development hereby approved, and permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Development in accordance with specified drawings and documents

conditions.summary: External materials to match existing building
conditions.text: All external materials to be used in the development shall match the appearance of those of the existing building, unless otherwise stated in the submitted application form or approved drawings.

conditions.summary: Cycle storage to be provided prior to occupation
conditions.text: Prior to occupation of the dwelling hereby approved, cycle storage shall be provided within the curtilage of the development, within secure, lockable compounds in accordance with the designated locations identified in the approved drawings listed under condition 2 and all adopted standards prior to the first occupation of the building. The storage spaces shall be permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.text: The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until refuse and recycling storage within a secure enclosure has been provided in accordance with the designated location identified in the approved drawings listed under condition 2 and in accordance with the Local Planning Authority Standards and has been fully implemented and made available for use. These facilities shall permanently retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping to be carried out with tree maintenance
conditions.text: Prior to first occupation of the development, hard and soft landscaping works, including trees shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details on the submitted Landscaping Plan and Planting Scheme. Any trees or other plants, which die or are removed within the first five years following the implementation of the landscaping scheme, shall be replaced during the next planting season, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Development to accord with Drainage Strategy
conditions.text: The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Drainage Strategy by John Davies Associates (November 2024 (Revision D) referenced in Condition 2 and maintained as such thereafter.

conditions.summary: Energy measures including solar PV and battery storage
conditions.text: The measures identified in the Energy Statement by ATSPACE (October 2025) shall be implemented including the installation of Solar PV (total of 18kW with 2x8kW Battery Storage) and maintained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Solar PV equipment to adhere to General Permitted Development conditions
conditions.text: Any solar PV or solar thermal equipment installed on the roof of the subject dwellinghouse must adhere to the of provisions, limitation and conditions of Schedule 2, Part 14, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015.

conditions.summary: No extension or alteration without planning permission
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification, no extension, enlargement or other alteration of the new dwellinghouse other than that expressly authorised by this permission shall be carried out without planning permission first obtained from the local planning authority.

conditions.summary: Noise assessment report and sound insulation requirements
conditions.text: A noise assessment report shall be submitted to the Council for approval in writing, of external noise sources including transport/ industrial/ commercial/ cultural uses and their noise levels occurring at the site during most of the year, i.e. measured during school and work weekdays, in accordance with internal noise limits specified in BS8233:2014, including the aircraft noise data in Section 6, SPG10 (worst mode aircraft 1-day noise contour (60 dB). Details shall include the sound insulation of the building envelope including glazing specifications (laboratory tested including frames, seals and any integral ventilators, approved in accordance with BS EN ISO 10140-2:2010) and of acoustically attenuated mechanical ventilation and cooling as necessary (with air intake from the cleanest aspect of the building and details of self-noise) Best practicable mitigation measures shall also be implemented, as necessary, in external amenity spaces to achieve criteria of BS8233:2014. The approved details shall be implemented prior to occupation of the development and thereafter be permanently retained.

conditions.summary: Plant noise limits assessed to BS4142:2014
conditions.text: The rating noise level (LAr,Tr) of the individual and combined maximum noise emitted by plant, ducting and equipment at the development site shall be lower than the lowest existing background sound level by at least 10dBA, as measured at/ calculated to the nearest and most affected noise sensitive premises at the development site and at surrounding premises. The assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 +A1 2019, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

conditions.summary: Anti-vibration isolation for machinery and plant
conditions.text: Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment/ extraction/ ventilation system and ducting at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such.

conditions.summary: Rooflights to not protrude beyond roof plane
conditions.text: The rooflights hereby approved shall not protrude more than 0.15 metres beyond the plane of the slope of the original roof when measured from the perpendicular with the external surface of the original roof.
