The Plan shall include full details of the biodiversity enhancements to be implemented on-site. The Plan shall include: A detailed, scaled soft landscaping plan, planting schedule and relevant habitat management measures; The enhancement of hedgerow habitat as shown on drawing As Existing Site Plan, dated February 2026, by WS Planning Architecture; Provision of one suitably placed bat and/or bird boxes, with the exact locations, make and model and height from ground level shown on scaled plans suitable for construction.

conditions.summary: Replacement of trees or shrubs

conditions.summary: Car parking spaces availability and retention

conditions.summary: Prohibition of burning straw on site
conditions.text: The burning of straw within the site is prohibited at all times and no such activities shall take place within the site without the prior written agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Five year limited period for gypsy traveller use
conditions.text: The use of the site as a gypsy traveller site shall be for a limited period being the period of 5 years from the date of this decision. At the end of this period the use hereby permitted shall cease, all caravans, structures, materials and equipment brought onto, or erected on the land, or works undertaken to it in connection with the use of the site for the siting of mobile homes and touring caravans shall be removed, and the land restored to its condition before the development took place.

conditions.summary: Parking space minimum dimensions 5m x 2.5m

conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: LCS - SD 01 01 DNO Substation Floor plan; LCS - SD 01 02 DNO Substation Elevations and Dimensions Plan; LCS - SD 02 02 Customer Substation Elevations and Dimensions Plan; LCS - SD 03 01 Indicative CCTV Post - standard drawings; LCS - SD 04 02 Security Fence and CCTV standard detail; LCS - SD 08 02 Inverter elevations and dimension plan; LCS - SD 011 40ft Battery container (HVAC on ground) standard detail; LCS - SD 015 01 Customer substation Floor plan; LCS - SD 016 01 Inverter Floor plan; LCS - SD 017 01 Panel Arrangement 4 Landscape 29.5 tilt; LCS068 - DZ 01 03 Tonbridge Solar Farm Development Zone Plan; LCS068 - PLE - 01 Rev 08 - Tonbridge Layout Plan external Layout Plan; LCS068 - SP 01 Rev 05 - Site location plan; Arboricultural Impact Assessment September 2022; Ecological Appraisal Parts 1 & 2; 6044715-M011-003-110 Alders Road Existing forward visibility.

conditions.summary: Detailed plans for finishes, layout and design of structures
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted plans and documents, no development shall take place until detailed plans and information regarding the following aspects of the proposed development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority: a) details of finishes of ancillary buildings (e.g. colour and materials); b) Detailed layout of the solar arrays, cable runs, DNO and private switchgrear, inverter stations, security fencing and CCTV/thermal imaging cameras, at a minimum scale of 1:100; c) Details of the design, external appearance, finish and scale of the DNO Switchgear and private switchgear, inverter stations, security fence and CCTV/thermal imaging cameras, at a minimum scale of 1:50.

conditions.summary: 40-year retention period from first export date
conditions.text: The permission hereby approved is for the development to be retained for a period of not more than 40 years from the date when electricity is first exported to the National grid (First Export Date), or in the event that electricity is not exported, from the date that works first commenced on site. Written confirmation of the First Export Date will be submitted to the Local Planning Authority within one month of the First Export Date.

conditions.summary: Decommissioning and restoration scheme after 40-year period
conditions.text: No later than 12 months before the end of the 40 year period set out by condition 4, a decommissioning and restoration scheme (to restore the site for agricultural use) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall make provision for the removal of all above and below ground structures, equipment, (including security fencing) and materials from the site. The approved scheme shall be implemented within 6 months of the end of the 40 year period set out in Condition 4.

conditions.summary: Restoration scheme if panels cease operation for 6+ months
conditions.text: If any of the individual solar panels cease to export electricity to the grid for a continuous period of 6 months then, unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority, a scheme of restoration shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for written approval for the removal of the solar panel(s) and associated equipment and restoration of (that part of) the site for agricultural use. The approved scheme shall be fully implemented within 6 months of the date of approval.

conditions.summary: Archaeological field evaluation and investigation
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of development the applicant, or their agents or successors in title, will secure: i. archaeological field evaluation works in accordance with a specification and written timetable which has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority; and ii. further archaeological investigation, recording and reporting, determined by the results of the evaluation, in accordance with a specification and timetable which has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority; iii. a programme of post excavation assessment and publication.

conditions.summary: Archaeological landscape survey and safeguarding measures
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development the applicant, or their agents or successors in title, will secure the implementation of i. archaeological landscape survey works in accordance with a specification and written timetable which has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority; and ii. following on from the survey, any safeguarding measures to ensure preservation in situ of important archaeological landscape remains and/or further archaeological landscape features investigation and recording in accordance with a specification and timetable which has been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority.

conditions.summary: Detailed sustainable surface water drainage scheme
conditions.text: Development shall not begin in any phase until a detailed sustainable surface water drainage scheme for the site has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The detailed drainage scheme shall be based upon the Surface Water Drainage Strategy prepared by AECOM (26 Jan 2023) and shall demonstrate that the surface water generated by this development (for all rainfall durations and intensities up to and including the climate change adjusted critical 100 year storm) can be accommodated and disposed of without increase to flood risk on or off-site. The drainage scheme shall also demonstrate (with reference to published guidance) that silt and pollutants resulting from the site use can be adequately managed to ensure there is no pollution risk to receiving waters; appropriate operational, maintenance and access requirements for each drainage feature or SuDS component are adequately considered.

conditions.summary: Verification report for surface water drainage system
conditions.text: No building on any phase of the development hereby approved shall be brought into use until a Verification Report, pertaining to the surface water drainage system and prepared by a suitably competent person, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The Report shall demonstrate that the drainage system constructed is consistent with that which was approved. The Report shall contain information and evidence (including photographs) of details and locations of inlets, outlets and control structures; landscape plans; full as built drawings; information pertinent to the installation of those items identified on the critical drainage assets drawing; and, the submission of an operation and maintenance manual for the sustainable drainage scheme as constructed.

conditions.summary: Landscape, agricultural and ecological management plan (LAEMP)
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a landscape, agricultural and ecological management plan (LAEMP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The LAEMP shall include: a) Description and evaluation of features to be managed. b) Ecological trends and constraints on site that might influence management. c) Aims and objectives of management. d) Appropriate management options for achieving aims and objectives. e) Prescriptions for management options for each identified habitat and feature covered. f) Preparation of a work schedule (including an annual work plan capable of being rolled forward over the duration of the development) with recommendations for periodic review. g) Details of the body or organisation responsible for implementation of the plan and the resources both financial and personnel by which the LEMP will be implemented. h) Ongoing monitoring and remedial measures including regular review by accredited professionals.

conditions.summary: Mitigation strategy for protected species
conditions.text: No works that may affect species protected under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 shall be commenced on site until a mitigation strategy has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All works shall then proceed in accordance with the approved strategy.

conditions.summary: Construction Traffic Management Plan (CTMP)
conditions.text: No development shall commence until a Construction Traffic Management Plan (CTMP) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CTMP shall include: a) details of the construction vehicles (number, size and type); b) details of vehicular routes to and from the site and contractors' arrangements (compound, storage, parking, turning, surfacing, booking system, signage and wheel wash facilities); c) details of the site access points for post development maintenance vehicles; d) details of emergency contact numbers during the construction phase. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP)
conditions.text: No development shall commence until a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CEMP shall include details of ground anchoring, ground re-profiling works, HGV passing places on and off site. The CEMP shall reference and incorporate the recommendations for a scheme of ecological avoidance, mitigation and enhancement (condition 19). The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Construction Method Statement with dust and noise controls
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of the development a Construction Method Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The document shall be produced in accordance with the Code of Construction Practice and BS5228 Noise Vibration and Control on Construction and Open Sites, the Control of Dust from Construction Sites (BRE DTi Feb 2003) and the Institute of Air Quality Management (IAQM) Guidance on the Assessment of Dust from Demolition and Construction. The construction of the development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved methodology.

conditions.summary: No external lighting without written permission
conditions.text: No external lighting shall be installed on the site without the formal written permission of the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: No additional fencing or enclosure except as approved
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended) (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no fencing or means of enclosure other than those hereby approved, shall be erected within or around the site.

conditions.summary: Acoustic report addressing noise and low frequency noise limits
conditions.text: Prior to the first use of the site for the purpose hereby approved, an acoustic report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The report shall address the issue of noise (including low frequency noise) and vibration from the facility to ensure that there is no loss of amenity. The scheme shall ensure that the low frequency noise emitted from the equipment is controlled so that it does not exceed the Low Frequency Criterion Curve for the 10 to 160Hz third octave bands inside residential accommodation as described in The DEFRA Procedure for the assessment of low frequency noise complaints 2011 (NANR45). The equipment shall be maintained in a condition so that it complies with the levels and mitigation measures specified in the approved acoustic report.

conditions.summary: Scheme of ecological avoidance, mitigation and enhancement measures
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of the development, a scheme of ecological avoidance, mitigation and enhancement measures following the recommendations within the Ecological Impact Assessment shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall be carried out in full and in accordance with the timescales set out within the approved documents.

conditions.summary: Compliance with Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Tree Protection Plan
conditions.text: All construction and decommissioning activities shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Tree Protection Plan.

conditions.summary: Hard and soft landscaping scheme with replacement provisions
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development, details of hard and soft landscaping and a programme for implementation shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The submitted scheme shall include details of hard and soft landscape works, including planting plans, written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant establishment) and schedules of plants, noting species, sizes and proposed numbers/densities. Replacement planting shall include mature specimens. The works shall be carried out as approved in accordance with the programme for implementation. Any trees or plants which, within a period of five years from the completion of the development, die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of a similar size and species.

conditions.summary: Access and visibility splays details onto Alders Road
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development and notwithstanding the details submitted, full details of the access and visibility splays onto Alders Road, as shown on plan number: TB-ACM-XX-XX-DR-CE-1051, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and shall include: - Details of the access, surfacing for the first 20m from Alders Road into the site and gradient; - A timetable for implementation. There should be no obstruction to vision above 900mm above the carriageway level within the visibility splays, that shall be maintained in accordance with the approved details prior to commencement and maintained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Public highway and verge condition survey within 20m of access
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of development a public highway and verge condition survey within 20m of the site access(es) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The development shall then be carried out in accordance with these details, and shall not be varied without details being first submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Bat mitigation measures implementation

All works shall then proceed in accordance with the approved strategy.

conditions.summary: External lighting strategy approval

External lighting shall be installed in accordance with the approved details, and no further external lighting shall be installed at any subsequent time.

conditions.summary: Use restriction to B8 storage only

conditions.summary: Commencement within 3 years
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of 3 years from the date of this decision.

conditions.summary: Accordance with approved plans
conditions.text: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Plan No.: 1571 P002A - Proposed Site Location Plan & Site Plan; Plan No.: 1571 P006B - Proposed Ground Floor Plan; Plan No.: 1571 P007B - Proposed First Floor Plan; Plan No.: 1571 P008B - Proposed Loft Plan; Plan No.: 1571 P009B - Proposed Roof Plan; Plan No.: 1571 P010C - Proposed Front, Rear & Side Elevations; Plan No.: 1571 P011C - Proposed Side Elevations & Sections; Plan No.: 1571 P012A - Proposed Site Layout Plan; Plan No.: 1571 P012B - Proposed Site Layout Plan With Area To Be Demolished

conditions.summary: External materials samples and approval
conditions.text: Written details, including source/manufacturer, and photographic samples of all materials to be used externally (including details of finishes, as well as details for doors and windows) shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement (excluding the demolition of the existing Cottage) of the hereby approved development and the development shall be carried out using the approved external materials.

conditions.summary: Vehicle parking and turning spaces provision
conditions.text: The areas shown on Plan No.: 1571 P012A (Proposed Site Layout Plan) as vehicle parking/turning space shall be provided, surfaced and drained in accordance with details submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority before any unit/bedroom is occupied, and shall be retained for the use of the occupiers of, and visitors to, the development and no permanent development...shall be carried out on these areas of land so shown or in such a position as to preclude vehicular access to the reserved parking spaces.

conditions.summary: Access maintenance and approval
conditions.text: The access shall be maintained in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of any hereby approved unit/bedroom.

conditions.summary: Soft and hard landscape scheme approval
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development (excluding the demolition of the existing Cottage and the commencement of construction of the development below ground level), a soft and hard landscape scheme designed in accordance with the principles of the Council's landscape character guidance shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall show all existing trees, hedges and blocks of landscaping...and shall indicate whether they are to be retained or removed...The approved scheme shall be implemented in accordance with an agreed programme of implementation.

conditions.summary: Landscape implementation and maintenance
conditions.text: The planting, seeding, turfing and hard landscaping specified in the approved landscape scheme shall be fully completed within the first planting season following first occupation of any unit/bedroom, or completed in accordance with an agreed programme of implementation. All such soft landscaping shall be carried out during the planting season (October to February). Any seeding or turfing which fails to establish or any trees or plants which die or become so seriously damaged or diseased that their long-term amenity value has been adversely affected shall be replaced in the next planting season with plants of the same species and size as detailed in the approved landscape scheme.

conditions.summary: Biodiversity avoidance, mitigation and enhancement scheme
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of development, a scheme of avoidance, mitigation, and enhancement of biodiversity on the site shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall take account of any protected species that have been identified on the site, shall take into account the recommendations of the submitted Preliminary Ecological Assessment and other Surveys and shall have regard to the enhancement of biodiversity generally. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved proposals within it and shall be thereafter maintained in perpetuity.

conditions.summary: Badger walkover survey within three months prior to commencement
conditions.text: In accordance with the recommendations of the Badger Activity Survey Report, a badger walkover survey of the site shall be carried out, and submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval, within the three months prior to commencement to check for any recent activity conclusive of badger presence.

conditions.summary: Bat emergence and re-entry survey or visual inspection
conditions.text: In accordance with the Recommendations of the Bat Emergence and Re-Entry Surveys Report, if works to remove the Gardener's Cottage commence prior to May 2026, the results from a visual inspection to be undertaken by a suitably qualified ecologist shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. If works commence during or after May 2026, an updated inspection and dusk emergence survey shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The removal of any roof tiles will be carried out by hand under the supervision of a suitably qualified ecologist.

conditions.summary: Restriction to C2 residential home use only
conditions.text: The premises/site shall be used for C2 (residential home) use only and not for any other purpose whether or not in the same use class of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or any subsequent Order revoking or re-enacting that Order, or whether the alternative use is permitted by virtue of Article 3 and Schedule 2 Part 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended) or any order revoking or re-enacting that Order.

conditions.summary: Minimum 600mm freeboard above flood level with climate change allowance
conditions.text: Finished floor levels (FFL) for the building extension shall be set to have a minimum 600mm freeboard above the 1% AEP (1 in 100 years) flood level, including the climate change allowance, in accordance with the approved Plan Nos.: 1571 P010C and 1571 P011C.

conditions.summary: Site-specific flood warning and evacuation plan
conditions.text: Prior to the first occupation of any part of the development hereby approved, a site-specific flood warning and evacuation plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority (LPA).

conditions.summary: Archaeological watching brief
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development (excluding the demolition of the existing Cottage) the applicant, or their agents or successors in title, shall secure the implementation of a watching brief to be undertaken by an archaeologist approved by the Local Planning Authority so that the development works are observed and items of interest and finds are recorded. The watching brief shall be in accordance with a written programme and specification which has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Detailed sustainable surface water drainage scheme with SuDS
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development (excluding the demolition of the existing Cottage) a detailed sustainable surface water drainage scheme for the site shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The submitted scheme shall demonstrate compliance with the required technical standards at the time of submission and shall demonstrate that the surface water generated by this development (for all rainfall durations and intensities up to and including the climate change adjusted critical 100 year storm) can be accommodated and disposed of without increase to flood risk on or off-site. The detailed drainage scheme shall incorporate permeable paving and other attenuation devices, and discharge surface water at a rate not exceeding 2 litres per second...The drainage scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Surface water drainage verification report before occupation
conditions.text: No hereby approved unit/bedroom shall be occupied until a Verification Report, pertaining to the surface water drainage system and prepared by a suitably competent person, has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The Report shall demonstrate that the drainage system constructed is consistent with that which was approved. The Report shall contain information and evidence (including photographs) of details and locations of inlets, outlets and control structures; landscape plans; full as built drawings; information pertinent to the installation of those items identified on the critical drainage assets drawing; and, the submission of an operation and maintenance manual for the sustainable drainage scheme as constructed.

conditions.summary: Internal noise levels and external amenity area noise (BS 8233 2014)
conditions.text: Prior to commencement of development (excluding the demolition of the existing Cottage and the commencement of construction of the development below ground level) a scheme to demonstrate that the internal noise levels within the residential units/bedrooms and the external noise levels in garden and other relevant amenity areas will conform to the standard identified by BS 8233 2014 (Sound Insulation and Noise Reduction for Buildings) shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The work specified in the approved scheme shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation of the premises and be retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: External lighting scheme with ILE guidance compliance
conditions.text: No external lighting shall be installed until a detailed scheme of lighting has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development. This scheme shall take note of, and refer to, the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Lighting, GN01, dated 2005 (and any subsequent revisions) and shall include a layout plan with beam orientation and a schedule of light equipment proposed (luminaire type; mounting height; aiming angles and luminaire profiles) and an ISO lux plan showing light spill. The scheme of lighting shall be installed, maintained, and operated in accordance with the approved scheme.

conditions.summary: Renewable energy technologies (PV panels and air source heat pumps)
conditions.text: Prior to commencement, written and illustrative details for renewable energy technologies within the development (that could include provision of PV panels and air source heat pumps) shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details which shall be retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: External materials to be in accordance with application details
conditions.text: The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of external materials specified in the application which shall not be varied without details being first submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Detailed joinery drawings for windows (1:5 or 1:1 scale)
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the details hereby approved, prior to the commencement of the installation of new windows within either new or existing openings, detailed drawings to a scale 1:5 or 1:1 of all new joinery shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall include sections, mouldings and glazing bars to a scale of 1:1 or 1:2 and means of fixing glazing. Details of finishes shall also be included. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

conditions.summary: Protection of trees and planting during construction
conditions.text: The approved development shall be carried out in such a manner as to avoid damage to the existing trees, including their root systems, and other planting to be retained by observing the following: • All trees to be preserved shall be marked on site and protected during any operation on site by temporary fencing in accordance with BS 5837. Such tree protection measures shall remain throughout the period of construction; • No fires shall be lit within the spread of branches or upwind of the trees and other vegetation; • No materials or equipment shall be stored within the spread of the branches or Root Protection Area of the trees and other vegetation; • No roots over 50mm diameter shall be cut, and no buildings, roads or other engineering operations shall be constructed or carried out within the spread of the branches or Root Protection Areas of the trees and other vegetation; • Ground levels within the spread of the branches or Root Protection Areas (whichever the greater) of the trees and other vegetation shall not be raised or lowered in relation to the existing ground level, except as may be otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. • No trenches for underground services shall be commenced within the Root Protection Areas of trees which are identified as being retained in the approved plans, or within 5m of hedgerows shown to be retained without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority. Such trenching as might be approved shall be carried out to National Joint Utilities Group recommendations.

conditions.summary: Internal and external noise levels to comply with BS 8233 2014
conditions.text: Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved (excluding the partial demolition hereby approved), a scheme to demonstrate that the internal noise levels within the residential units and the external noise levels in back garden and other relevant amenity areas will conform to the standard identified by BS 8233 2014, Sound Insulation and Noise Reduction for Buildings - shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The work specified in the approved scheme shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of the premises and be retained thereafter.

conditions.summary: Vehicle parking provision prior to first occupation
conditions.text: The area shown on the approved drawings as vehicle parking space shall be provided prior to the first occupation of any of the units, and shall be retained for the use of the occupiers of, and visitors to, the development, and no permanent development, whether or not permitted by the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order), shall be carried out on that area of land so shown or in such a position as to preclude vehicular access to this reserved parking space.

conditions.summary: Bicycle and refuse storage to be completed before first occupation
conditions.text: The bicycle and refuse storage facilities shown on the approved plans shall be completed and made available for use prior to first occupation of the hereby approved, and thereafter retained.

conditions.summary: Fencing and boundary treatment details to be approved
conditions.text: Notwithstanding the submitted drawings, prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of any new proposed fencing/boundary treatments shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The boundary treatments shall then be erected in accordance with the approved details, and no further boundary treatments shall be erected unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

conditions.summary: Retention and replacement of trees, hedges and hedgerows
conditions.text: All existing trees, hedges or hedgerows shall be retained, unless shown on the approved drawings as being removed. All trees, hedges and hedgerows on and immediately adjoining the site shall be protected from damage for the duration of works on the site. Any trees, or parts of hedges or hedgerows removed without the Local Planning Authority's prior written consent or which die or become, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously diseased or otherwise damaged within five years following contractual practical completion of the approved development shall be replaced as soon as is reasonably practicable and, in any case, by not later than the end of the first available planting season, with plants of such size and species and in such positions as may be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
